sources.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources.extracted: curse amplifier = x1.12, scoped to MAGIC damage only, and gated on a 700-unit radius around the Abyssal Mask holder

sources.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources.extracted: vulnerable amplifier = x1.07, type-agnostic (all damage types), gated on the target being immobilized
the Unmake curse is a unique named debuff on the target; it is one debuff on the enemy, not a per-holder stack
cached item text is pinned at patch 16.15, i.e. current for this baseline

sources.quote: post = raw · m(R) ... The engine's per-step composition reproduces this closed form exactly
sources.extracted: mitigation is a single multiplicative factor applied to raw damage; document contains NO clause making an outgoing amplifier type-agnostic, so amplifier scoping is governed by the item text alone

step_1_ratio.reading: the two leaves differ by exactly one application of a x1.12 factor (1.12 within the rounding of a 1-decimal leaf); the only x1.12 amplifier in this scenario is Abyssal Mask's Unmake curse

step_2_shared_base.hypothesis: old = base x 1.07 x 1.12 (Vulnerable AND Curse); new = base x 1.07 (Vulnerable only)
step_2_shared_base.conclusion: both leaves share one pre-amplifier base of ~155.88; the delta is exactly the Curse factor being applied vs not applied

step_3_stacking_mode_excluded.test: could the pair instead be additive stacking (1 + 0.07 + 0.12 = 1.19) collapsing to Vulnerable-only?
step_3_stacking_mode_excluded.conclusion: windows are disjoint, so additive stacking is ruled out. The engine composes independent amplifiers multiplicatively (x1.07 x 1.12 = x1.1984), which matches the game rule that separate damage-amplification sources multiply. The change is therefore a pure toggle of the Curse factor, NOT a change of stacking mode or of either amplifier's magnitude.

step_4_alternate_but_equivalent_reading.hypothesis: old = base x 1.07 x 1.12^2 (Curse counted twice, e.g. two roster members carrying Abyssal Mask); new = base x 1.07 x 1.12 (counted once)
step_4_alternate_but_equivalent_reading.conclusion: also self-consistent, and also resolves to 'one x1.12 too many was being applied'. Unmake is flagged unique in the cached data, so a single enemy carries one Unmake debuff regardless of how many roster members hold the item -- double application would be wrong.

step_5_which_leaf_the_item_text_supports.rule_from_wiki: Vulnerable (x1.07) applies to 'damage they take from all sources' = every damage type. Unmake (x1.12) applies only to 'increased magic damage' and only inside 700 units of the Abyssal Mask holder.
step_5_which_leaf_the_item_text_supports.consequence: the two amplifiers are NOT co-extensive: every event that receives the Curse must also be magic damage AND in range of the holder. Any event that is physical or true damage, or whose target is outside the holder's 700-unit aura, or that would apply a second copy of the unique Unmake debuff, must carry x1.07 alone -- i.e. 166.8, not 186.8.
step_5_which_leaf_the_item_text_supports.conclusion: the new value is the value produced when the magic-only / unique / radius-gated amplifier is withheld while the type-agnostic amplifier is kept. That is precisely the behavior the cached item text mandates for a non-magic, out-of-aura, or already-cursed event.

reasoning: The leaf moved by exactly one factor of 1.12 on an unchanged pre-amplifier base (155.88), with the 1.07 Imperial Mandate factor retained in both. Additive stacking is arithmetically excluded, so this is a clean toggle of the Abyssal Mask Unmake amplifier. The cached wiki text scopes that amplifier three ways -- magic damage only, 700-unit radius around the holder, and a unique (non-stacking) debuff -- while Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is explicitly type-agnostic ('all sources'). The old leaf applied both amplifiers to the same event; the new leaf applies only the unrestricted one. In a roster scenario, whose whole purpose is aggregating amplifiers contributed by other champions on the field, the value that withholds the narrowly-scoped magic-only aura from an event that does not qualify is the one the source text supports, and 166.8 reproduces to the digit (155.888 x 1.07 = 166.800).
residual_uncertainty: The exported evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) does not contain the scenario definition -- no file under data/ mentions 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster', and the golden baseline and scenario builder live under scripts/, which this runbook forbids. I therefore could not read back event[14]'s damage type, its target, or which roster member holds each item; that identification is inferred from the arithmetic (a single x1.12 toggle on a shared base) rather than read directly. The verdict would invert only if event[14] is in fact magic damage dealt to a target legitimately inside a single ally Abyssal holder's 700-unit aura -- in which case both amplifiers apply and 186.8 would stand. Every other configuration permitted by the quoted item text (physical or true damage, out-of-aura target, or a second copy of the unique Unmake debuff) yields 166.8.
confidence: high on the structure (single x1.12 amplifier toggled, multiplicative composition, both amplifier magnitudes unchanged and correct per patch-16.15 cached text); moderate on the direction, conditional on event[14] not being an in-aura magic-damage event as noted above.
